note: A validate step lists every unknown and every absent argument, one refusal each, in the arguments stage, each naming its own argument and the JSON Pointer to it. Opening a roster with a stray key and no name breaks both gates at once; Ruby's Dispatcher#validate and the kernel's collecting dry run must list the same refusals, in the same order, with the same text.
